Pricing.title: Affordable, flexible pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Pick the bundle that matches how often you want to practice.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Common questions about pricing, attempts, and how practice works.

q1.question: How much does it cost?
q1.answer: Your first practice exam is completely free. After that, top up your wallet and continue for a small fee per attempt.

q2.question: What happens if I don't pass?
q2.answer: There's no limit on practice attempts — top up and try again as many times as you like until you feel ready.

q3.question: Can I review my mistakes?
q3.answer: Yes. Once you finish an exam, you'll see your score and an explanation for every question, including the ones you got wrong.

q4.question: What languages are supported?
q4.answer: The site is available in English, Kinyarwanda, and French. Exam questions themselves are currently in Kinyarwanda only.
